P.</ls> .²3 To cry out, exclaim. .²4 To yell, howl. .²5 To neigh (as a horse); हरिर्वाजमचिक्रन्दत् <ls>Rv. 9. 67. 4</ls>. .²6 To roar. .²7 To creak (as a wheel). €10 <ab>P.</ab> or {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cry out continuously. .²2 To roar, rave. .²3 To cause to weep.
